items.name: r-amber
items.subject: AMBER, the game's main resource: a compact cluster of three big smooth, glossy, translucent amber nuggets of warm honey-orange, glowing softly from within like hardened tree resin. Warm orange and gold only.

items.name: r-substance
items.subject: SUBSTANCE, the forest's raw magic, one of the game's two resources: a compact cluster of translucent, faceted violet-blue crystal shards growing out of a small dark root knot, glowing from within with deep violet and blue light. Never green.

items.name: r-lumber
items.subject: WOOD, a resource: a small stack of three cut twig logs bound with a cord, pale fresh-cut ends showing their rings, warm brown bark.

items.name: r-supply
items.subject: SUPPLY (how many troops a colony can feed): a small woven bark basket heaped with plump golden seeds and grains.
